Giver: Okay, we're going to start at the cross and head to the other cross. First, go up a little bit, then turn left.
Follower: Alright, I'm starting. I go up a bit, turn left... okay, that's a path.
Giver: Good. Now, do you see the diamond mine? It's to the left of us.
Follower: Yeah, I see it. It's there.
Giver: Okay, so you go past the diamond mine, but keep it on your left side. Then, turn right.
Follower: Right, past the mine, turn right... oh, wait. There's a river here. Is that the one?
Giver: Yes, that's the fast flowing river. Go along it. Keep the graveyard on your left.
Follower: Okay, I'm along the river now. The graveyard is on my left... wait, the graveyard isn't on my map.
Giver: Right, ignore that. Just keep going along the river. Now, turn left. Do you see the Apache camp?
Follower: I see the Apache camp, yeah.
Giver: Okay, you need to turn right towards the Apache camp, then turn left again and pass the carved wooden pole on your right.
Follower: Wait, there's only one carved wooden pole on my map, and it's way down here...
Giver: No, there are two. One up here, one way down. You missed the first one. Go back to the river, turn left, pass the pole on your right.
Follower: Ah! Okay, there it is. Turn left, pass the pole on the right... okay, got it. Now turn left again.
Giver: Good. Now head towards the walled city. Keep the walled city on your left.
Follower: Okay, heading for the city. City is on my left... okay, good. Now turn right, go up past the flat rocks.
Giver: Wait, do you see the flat rocks?
Follower: Yeah, right there.
Giver: Okay, pass them on your left. Now, go up towards the stone creek.
Follower: Stone creek is here. Okay. Now turn right, go up. Do you see the buffalo?
Giver: Yes, go towards the buffalo. Keep it on your right.
Follower: Okay, buffalo is on my right. Good. Now turn left, go towards the cattle ranch.
Giver: Pass the cattle ranch on your left. Keep going.
Follower: Okay, passing the ranch... wait, where does the route go now?
Giver: Now you turn right, go towards the fort. Keep the fort on your right.
Follower: Fort is here. Okay, turn right... wait, the fort is on my left on my map!
Giver: That's because the fort is on the right in my map. You're close, but you're going the wrong way. Turn left, go towards the fort.
Follower: Okay, turn left... oh, now the fort is on my right. Okay, passing the fort on the right. Now go up a bit.
Giver: Good. Now turn right, go towards the other carved wooden pole.
Follower: Oh! There's another pole way down here. I didn't know there was two. Okay, heading for the bottom pole.
Giver: Right, that's the one. Keep it on your right. Now turn left, go towards the finish.
Follower: Okay, turn left... wait, the finish isn't on my map.
Giver: The finish is where we started, but way down south. Look for the fort and the ranch, go past them, then turn left towards the bottom edge.
Follower: Ah! Okay, past the ranch, turn left... I see the finish mark now? No, that's not it.
Giver: Keep going left until you hit the edge. You should see the finish cross.
Follower: Okay, I'm going left... I see a cross! Is that it?
Giver: Yes! That's the finish. You're done.
Follower: Whoa, okay. I thought I was lost. Thanks!
Giver: No problem. You missed the second pole, but you figured it out.
Follower: Yeah, almost missed it. I'm done.
